rules: Every shipped valid feature is RequiredCurrent; consumer surfaces may not remove, optionalize, or externalize a row.
A playground gap keeps product promotion blocked until an executable route and replay case exist.
A NativeOnly operation claimed browser-executable requires shipped browser build evidence; otherwise the claim is rejected.
Inspection-rail answers are labelled and never substitute semantic-rail answers.
Maturity and catalog truth come from the producing owner and catalogs/product-surface-catalog.toml, never from a surface's presentation.
